mentions.name: Hoopi Pedal
mentions.description: A 2-channel digital effects and recording pedal based on the Daisy Seed and ESP32, covering PCB design, embedded firmware (including OTA updates), DSP, and a companion Flutter app that uses native methods and auto cross-correlation for video-audio sync.
mentions.source_excerpt: Hoopi Pedal: A 2-channel digital effects + recording pedal, based on the Daisy Seed and the ESP32 [1]. PCB design, embedded firmware, DSP and Flutter app - all are mine.
